openBugs.summary: hero-case-detail RSC abort + HMR cascade — NOW CAUSING 8+ FULL-SUITE FAILURES

openBugs.summary: hero-lookup flaky under full-suite 4-worker load — passes in isolation
openBugs.rootCause: dev-server resource contention; not a product bug
openBugs.fix: run in isolation or use a production build

openBugs.summary: bulk bar Export area has white-on-white progress elements
openBugs.rootCause: documents-browser.tsx — progress/spinner elements not inheriting dark bulk-bar colors
openBugs.fix: set explicit text-* classes on the export progress elements inside the bulk bar

openBugs.summary: redirect()-only stub pages trip ERR_ABORTED gate in harness
openBugs.rootCause: scripts/gen-routes.mjs includes these stubs; their 307 redirect + RSC cancel reads as failed request
openBugs.fix: exclude redirect-only routes from gen-routes, or add {failedRequests: false} option

openBugs.summary: 100 judgment rows with no pagination UI — hardcoded limit:100
openBugs.rootCause: search/judgments/page.tsx:116 has limit: 100 with no <Pagination> wired up
openBugs.fix: wire the <Pagination> component from WO-39 (already used on cases/clients)

openBugs.summary: E2E_ROUTE_IDS['id'] is shared across ALL dynamic routes — only one entity gets a valid UUID per run
openBugs.rootCause: scripts/gen-routes.mjs + seededUrl() always use the key 'id' regardless of entity type
openBugs.fix: rename params per entity: matterId, clientId, documentId, draftId, invoiceId

openBugs.summary: Upload dropzone has unlabeled file input (WCAG A violation)
openBugs.rootCause: input[type=file] in upload dropzone component lacks aria-label — different from F2 (which was assistant/draft, now fixed)
openBugs.fix: Add aria-label to the file input in src/app/dashboard/documents/ upload component

openBugs.summary: Voice page uses raw native browser file input instead of styled dropzone
openBugs.rootCause: AUDIO FILE section renders unstyled native <input type=file> Choose File button — does not match design system
openBugs.fix: Use the same custom FileDropzone component as /dashboard/documents

openBugs.summary: Voice page: from_number tel input has no aria-label (WCAG A)
openBugs.rootCause: input[type=tel][name=from_number] lacks aria-label and associated label
openBugs.fix: Add aria-label='Caller phone number' or wrap in label

openBugs.summary: Voice page: consent_disclosed checkbox has no label (WCAG A)
openBugs.fix: Add label htmlFor or aria-label for DPDP consent checkbox

openBugs.summary: Messages page: 2 text inputs (recipient, message) unlabeled (WCAG A)
openBugs.rootCause: WhatsApp/SMS composer inputs lack aria-label or associated label elements
openBugs.fix: Add aria-label or label htmlFor to recipient number and message body inputs

openBugs.summary: Advocate dossier shows bare 404 instead of designed empty state when API has no data
openBugs.rootCause: Page calls notFound() on null profile; results in raw Next.js 404 with no recovery path
openBugs.fix: Return designed empty-state with 'Advocate data not yet synced' + Refresh button instead of notFound()
